description: This Java class defines an immutable data model named 'Metadata', which represents metadata information about a database record related to 'thingEntities'. It includes fields like thingId, revision, policyId, policyRevision, and modification timestamp, along with factory methods for creation and a fromResponse method for recovery from an update response.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: An immutable data class encapsulating metadata details relevant to a 'thing' entity in a database, including identifiers, revision numbers, optional policy associations, and last modification timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified thingId, thingRevision, optional policyId, and optional policyRevision. Does not specify a modification timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Metadata instance with specified values including a modification timestamp.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Constructs a Metadata instance from an UpdateThingResponse object, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this metadata.

methods.name: getThingRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Thing as per the search index.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyId, if present.

methods.name: getPolicyIdInPersistence
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId as a String suitable for persistence, or an empty string if absent.

methods.name: getPolicyRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the Policy revision number, if available.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the last modification, if available.
